run_bm_cameras: run the camera benchmark suite that benchmarks projection and unprojection across all camera types
run_bm_cameras_project: run the benchmark for camera point projection across all camera types and devices
run_bm_cameras_unproject: run the benchmark for camera point unprojection across all camera types and devices
review_bm_cameras: review the camera benchmark module that tests transform and unproject points for 9 camera types
refactor_bm_cameras: refactor the camera benchmark setup to add new camera types or test parameters
